attachment_owner_check.name: attachment_owner_check
attachment_owner_check.value: "attachment"."quote_id" is not null or "attachment"."draft_id" is not null or "attachment"."removed_at" is not null

capacity_evidence_pct_check.name: capacity_evidence_pct_check
capacity_evidence_pct_check.value: "capacity_evidence"."assumed_effectiveness_pct" between 0 and 100 and "capacity_evidence"."utilization_pct" between 0 and 100 and ("capacity_evidence"."buffer_pct" is null or "capacity_evidence"."buffer_pct" between 0 and 100)

quote_closure_complete_check.name: quote_closure_complete_check
quote_closure_complete_check.value: "quote"."status" <> 'closed' or ("quote"."outcome" is not null and "quote"."outcome_reason_code" is not null and "quote"."closure_owner_id" is not null)

quote_draft_one_open_rework_uidx.name: quote_draft_one_open_rework_uidx
quote_draft_one_open_rework_uidx.where: "quote_draft"."rework_of_quote_id" is not null and "quote_draft"."submitted_quote_id" is null

notification_email_due_idx.name: notification_email_due_idx
notification_email_due_idx.where: "notification"."channel" = 'email' and "notification"."sent_at" is null and "notification"."failed_at" is null

notification_delivery_state_check.name: notification_delivery_state_check
notification_delivery_state_check.value: not ("notification"."sent_at" is not null and "notification"."failed_at" is not null)
